answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake for one epoch and build a reputation trellis only through verified jobs. Like jade, that reputation is slow to carve, so a new identity cannot instantly look trustworthy. Before trading, each identity must also finish a basalt-hard proof of useful work. Creating one fake account is cheap, but creating thousands means locking thousands of stakes and doing thousands of proofs, while honest agents get their stake back. Sybil cost thus grows linearly with each identity.
